messages:
tara: Dropped a compact-rail + routing appendix in Figma and RFC. Goals: simplify primary nav, keep deep links reliable, and make collapsed groups keyboard-friendly. Figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-rail \ . RFC: /docs/nav-compact-rail.md :point_down:

mike: skimmed. Agree on simplifying. Quick permalinks Q: we have lots of external links to /console/models/:id and /console/models/:id/versions. What's the plan to avoid breaking those?

zoe: my take: 301 rewrites for public routes + runtime fallback for internal routes while we roll out. Add an HTTP response header like `X-Deprecated-Path: /console/models/:id` so downstream crawlers know.

rashid: a11y note: when a group collapses, focus needs to move to the toggle button and screen readers should hear "Models collapsed". Use `aria-expanded` and an `aria-live="polite"` region for state announcements. Also increase hit target to 44px and bump chevron stroke for contrast.

design-bot: [a11y-scan] compact-rail icons contrast ratio 3.7:1 on accent bg; recommended: stroke +1px or use fill color #f3f4f6 for >=4.5:1. Also flagged missing aria-label on utility rail toggle.

olga: breadcrumbs suggestion: use slash separators and keep the root crumb stable ("Models / MyModel / Versions"). Truncation rules: always keep the first and last crumb visible, ellipsize middle. Tooltips on hover for truncated crumbs.

mike: routing edge-case: some older links embed the view in the path e.g. `/console/models/123/versions` while new plan uses query `?tab=versions`. We should support both and map `/versions` -> `?tab=versions` in a canonical rewrite table. Also record original path as `?legacy=/models/123/versions` for analytics.

zoe: here's a tiny helper for canonicalizing incoming URLs:
```
function canonicalize(url){
  // prefer explicit path segments, fall back to hash, normalize view -> query
  let path = url.pathname !== '/' ? url.pathname : (new URL(url).hash.replace('#',''))
  path = stripLegacyFragments(path)
  const { view } = parseLegacy(path)
  return { path: normalizePath(path), query: view ? { tab: view } : {} }
}
```
Use this on the client before router.resolve so we can safely redirect/fallback.

tara: routing resolution priority (agreeable proposal): 1) exact new path match, 2) server-side rewrite/301 map, 3) client canonicalize + query fallback, 4) hash fallback, 5) global search fallback page. Document this in RFC.

rashid: one more a11y microcopy: aria-current="page" on the active breadcrumb and mark separators `aria-hidden="true"`. Good to call out in the accessibility checklist.

olga: A/B test idea: slash vs chevron separators + compact vs expanded counts for collapsed groups. Metrics: breadcrumb click-through, time-to-first-action, nav abandonment. Start at 2% rollout.

zoe: actionables: (1) I'll draft the rewrite/301 table and sample responses (owner: zoe, due: Tue), (2) Mike to add analytics tags + legacy query param plan (owner: mike, due: Tue), (3) Rashid to add keyboard/aria checklist + focus-flow diagrams (owner: rashid, due: Wed), (4) Tara to update RFC with resolution priority and A/B plan (owner: tara, due: Thu).

tara: thanks all — will iterate figma with the contrast/hit-target fixes and post updated prototypes for testing. :raised_hands:
